title: Universal Approximation Theorem for Metaplectic Neural Operators
abstract: arXiv:2611.13991v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We prove universal approximation for metaplectic neural operators on nonempty bounded Lipschitz domains. The nonlocal branches are whole-space metaplectic multipliers with zero extension and restriction, associated with any fixed free symplectic matrix. Assuming a smooth, globally Lipschitz, nonpolynomial activation, we obtain compact-uniform approximation of continuous operators from $C^s$ to $C^r$ and from $H^s$ to $H^r$ in the respective output norms, for arbitrary nonnegative integers $s,r$ and finite input and output channel dimensions. In the Sobolev setting, compact input sets must additionally be uniformly bounded in $L^\infty$. One hidden operator layer with one nonlocal branch suffices. A single scalar symbol atom and finitely many positional features are prescribed by the transform and domain independently of the target operator, compact set and accuracy. translated_title: 亚辛神经算子的万能逼近定理
translated_abstract: 我们在非空有界 Lipschitz 区域上证明了亚辛神经算子的万能逼近性质。其非局部分支是带零延拓与零限制的全空间亚辛乘子，可与任意固定的自由辛矩阵相关联。在激活函数光滑、全局 Lipschitz 且非多项式的假设下，我们得到了从 $C^s$ 到 $C^r$ 以及从 $H^s$ 到 $H^r$ 的连续算子在相应输出范数下的紧一致逼近，其中 $s,r$ 为任意非负整数，输入与输出通道维数均为有限。在 Sobolev 情形下，输入紧集还需额外在 $L^\infty$ 中一致有界。仅需一个隐藏算子层及其中的单条非局部分支即可充分实现逼近。单个标量符号原子与有限多个位置特征由变换和区域预先确定，与目标算子、紧集及逼近精度无关。证明将平均化神经算子理论与精确的 chirp——（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文证明了亚辛神经算子的万能逼近定理：在非空有界Lipschitz区域上，仅需一个带单条非局部亚辛乘子分支的隐藏算子层，即可对从C^s到C^r以及H^s到H^r的连续算子实现紧一致逼近。
en_tdlr: This paper proves a universal approximation theorem for metaplectic neural operators, showing that a single hidden operator layer with one nonlocal metaplectic-multiplier branch suffices for compact-uniform approximation of continuous operators from C^s to C^r and from H^s to H^r on bounded Lipschitz domains.
